No approved convention exists for choosing which day a hidden SANS/venous onset is placed within the 30-day mission. Picking one (e.g. a fixed day, or a sampled day) requires a human-approved simulation-design rule - it is not itself a sourced scientific parameter, but assigning it without approval would silently bake in an unreviewed assumption, which this generator does not do.
